meta.coverage: October 2026 is covered systematically. Earlier cases (2014 to September 2026) were added on 12 November 2026 from three sources: Memorial's case cards for Ukrainians prosecuted by Russia, MIHR's monthly reviews of convicted civilians (April 2024 to October 2026), and verdicts posted by the occupation Zaporizhzhia regional court; and, added on 13 November 2026, people named or described in published reports and monitored pro-Russian media held in the TOT Insights research archive, including civilians detained without charge since 2014; and, also added on 13 November 2026, cases from the Office of the President's Representative in Crimea, the Crimean Tatar Resource Center, Crimean Solidarity, Krym.Realii, the Center for Civil Liberties, the Ukrainian Helsinki Human Rights Union, the Eastern Human Rights Group, Mediazona, the Southern District Military Court's website and the occupation courts in Donetsk, Luhansk and Kherson oblasts; and, added on 14 November 2026, cases from the archives of KHPG, ZMINA and the Crimean Human Rights Group (2014 onwards) and from the websites of the Supreme Court of Crimea, Sevastopol City Court, the Second Western and Central district military courts and the Military Court of Appeal. No month before October 2026 is complete.
